caseName: Texas A & M University v. Gay Student Services
caseNameFull: Texas A & M University v. Gay Student Services

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of appellants to disqualify counsel for appellees and to strike appel-lees’ motion to dismiss or affirm denied. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
